name: Elf
description: A customer who enters Mayuko's shop and orders an elixir that will give her even more elven features. She is very elitist and wants to feel even more superior to humans than she already does.

name: Ghost
description: A customer who enters Mayuko's shop and orders an elixir to calm its nerves. It is, in fact, terrified of ghosts (though it is one itself).

name: Mayuko
description: Originally from Rubea, where she experienced harrowing mind control at the hands of The Blight. When Marshmallow defeats her summoned golem, she returns to normal and becomes his ally, providing upgrades to his inventory capacity. Later, she becomes estranged from Marshmallow and Shadowfell as a whole, taking her experiments into her own hands, serving nobody. She is in the middle of an experiment involving a custom-made species of giant fuzzy bee. In an alternate timeline, she is the owner of a potion shop in Don't Drink That!

name: Bort
description: A customer who enters Mayuko's shop and orders an elixir that tastes really good. He wants to prove to his friends that he is a master chef.

name: Princess
description: A customer who enters Mayuko's shop and orders an elixir that will allow her to get rid of all the frog princes who want her to kiss them.

name: Vampire
description: A customer who enters Mayuko's shop and orders an elixir that will allow him to go out into the sun and eat a human.

name: Werewolf
description: A customer who enters Mayuko's shop and orders an elixir that will allow him to fall into a deep sleep and sleep through the night of a full moon.

name: Marshmallow
description: The playable protagonist of Rubea. He starts as a humble, no-name adventurer, but quickly meets many allies and grows stronger. Ultimately, he defeats the Voidmaster, the void-corrupted version of Wilbur from Enchanted. Later, he fathers a child with Kiina and establishes the kingdom of Shadowfell with her. The name Marshmallow is never mentioned in any updated media. His real name is Kazuki.

name: Naomi
description: A nurse from Ralnei. She is quite infatuated with Marshmallow, and will heal him for free. Her clinic serves as the player's respawn point if they are defeated.

name: Yukari
description: A local adventurer girl from Ralnei. She mans the mission board and exchanges mission tokens for various goods. Later, in Infinite Horizon, she mothers the protagonist, Hikari.

name: Fairy Princess
description: In Rubea, she is the ruler of Faemoore, the city where faerians live. She lets Marshmallow upgrade his max health and stamina, for a fee. Later, she is the cause of the Demon King's blindness, triggering the Shadowfell/Faemoore conflict. She is banished and usurped by the warrior princess Selina.

name: Irori
description: A unique-looking girl originally drawn as an homage to the Kong Strong energy drinks (featuring the blue, red and green flavors as inspiration). In Rubea, she lets Marshmallow customize his appearance.

name: Kiina
description: Originally known as the Hero Hunter. After she is defeated by Marshmallow, she joins him in combat - and as a romantic partner. Later, she becomes the queen of Shadowfell alongside her husband, the Demon King.

name: Kiyu
description: A mysterious fox girl living underneath The Permafrost. If you bring her a Tier X weapon, she will grant you a MAX Break version for 9999 Rubea.

name: Mei
description: A live-in maid from Ralnei. She resides in the house purchased by Marshmallow, and gives him access to the furniture store.

name: Noriko
description: A mysterious girl found in a red pocket dimension. She tasks the player with defeating every type of elite enemy, which hold the flames in which her powers lie. As Marshmallow restores flames, her powers gradually become stronger.

name: Yuki
description: A small girl originally found in a block of ice. When she is rescued, she grants the player the ice-walking boots and moves into The Life Tree with Mayuko.

name: Rat
description: The playable character, strategically placing apples and throwing bananas while weaving through enemy snakes.

name: Rift Leaper MC
description: The playable character, wielding a rocket launcher to rocket jump through an ever-changing world.

name: Knight Antivirus
description: The playable character, an antivirus program that fights off computer viruses with a heavy, physics-based weapon.

name: Teacher
description: Mika's lackadaisical teacher in Scarfcat. She smokes indoors and gives crappy advice, but she's down-to-earth and quite endearing.

name: Mika Kurosaki
description: The playable protagonist of Scarfcat, and best friend of Chiwa. Mika's solemn and cold demeanor hints at wisdom beyond her years - and a hidden, heavy burden. Though branded a delinquent, she'll stand her ground for her friends and ideals like no other. She is the owner of the third rift the Paradox Agents encounter in Wildfront.

name: Slime
description: The playable deuteragonist of Sticky Mechanic. Though small, they exhibit much compassion and heart, something sorely missing from Earth in 2089. Their speech is entirely in blobbish, unintelligible to humans (and players). Only their best friend, Dr. Palmer, understands them.

name: Aria Palmer
description: The protagonist of Sticky Mechanic. At a young age, her parents passed away and she was sent to an Avalonian orphanage. When it was discovered she was without an othermind, one was forcefully installed in her. In the aftermath of the impromptu surgery, she flees into the street in the pouring rain, where she experiences a fateful meeting with a slime who saves her life and becomes her closest companion.

name: Akari Sakai
description: The relentlessly teasing owner of Second Cycle, a repair shop localized in Osu Kannon. She helps Kenji dissassemble and strengthen gear.

name: Hibiki Kiriyama
description: Kenji's classmate and the owner of the first temporal rift the Paradox Agents encounter. She can be hot-headed and brash at times, but she is a valuable partner who emboldens the team with her cocky attitude.

name: Yuuna Shirokawa
description: The student council president of Yuugen High. Yuuna is well-bred as the heiress of the prestigious Shirokawa family and is mature and dutiful - even to a fault. She is the owner of the second rift the Paradox Agents encounter.

name: Chiwa Nishimiya
description: The chaotic president of the newspaper club. Endlessly cheerful and wildly determined, she'll chase a scoop to the ends of the earth without a second thought. Her bright energy is as contagious as her curiosity - when Chiwa catches the scent of a scoop, there's no stopping her. She is the owner of the fourth rift the Paradox Agents encounter.

name: Baru
description: A little creature that the Paradox Agents met while lost in Hibiki's temporal rift. Baru's origins are unknown, but he is next to none when it comes to knowledge about the timeline and its fractures.

name: Kenji Hoshino
description: The playable protagonist. He is a transfer student into class 2-A of Yuugen High, where he quickly gets involved with his temperamental classmate Hibiki and their mysterious mentor, Baru. He leads the Paradox Agents in their fight to mend the past.

name: Tamomo
description: The cranky lesser god of Kogane Shrine. Tamomo is a local deity whose influence has diminished over generations. He regards his dilapidated shrine, and his fading relevance, with a mixture of irritation and resignation. While outwardly pessimistic and curt, he's a dependable and shrewd businesscat who will sell you magical artifacts - for the right price.

name: Chibi-Chan
description: The mascot of wAIfu, illustrated by tacecapS. She serves as the avatar of the AI, predicting your opinions about waifus.

name: Hibiki
description: The princess heir of Shadowfell, and daughter of Marshmallow and Kiina. Despite her sheltered upbringing, Hibiki is a determined, independent young woman fit to rule a kingdom. With a keen intellect and a natural charisma, Hibiki commands the respect of both allies and adversaries alike.

name: Hikari
description: The playable protagonist of Infinite Horizon. Hikari grew up in Ralmere with her supportive mother, who is a retired adventurer. Hikari is a competent swordswoman and has a strong sense of justice. When she leaves Ralmere, she receives her absent father's sword to use in her quest.

name: Ryuuko
description: A great dragon, who was defeated by Marshmallow in Rubea, becoming his ally. She now takes the form of a little girl while she regains her strength as Shadowfell Castle's royal alchemist. Ryuuko works closely with the royal family to cure the Demon King of the illness that has befallen him because of the faerians.

name: Tori
description: The last harpy. When Tori hatched from her egg, she was not greeted by the face of a harpy, but with that of Marshmallow. Throughout her life, she has grown cold and bitter, but a warm heart resides within her, brought forth by Hikari in Infinite Horizon.

name: Ume
description: Ralmere's resident florist. She runs Ume's Flower Shop, where she sells neatly wrapped flower bouquets. With her endearing manner of speech and persistent optimism, Ume is a friend worth keeping around.

name: Vaeren
description: An infamous bounty hunter who hangs out at Ralmere's inn. Due to Hikari helping out her younger sister, Ume, Vaeren has agreed to provide Hikari with jobs to do for shards and experience. If you can endure her flirtatious teasing, she can be a strong ally.

name: Virin
description: A mysterious sentient voidborn who showed up at Hikari's household on a rainy night. Unlike other voidborn, Virin is free-thinking and helps Hikari with her void-related powers. Usually, she hides in Hikari's shadow to not cause unrest with her voidborn appearance.

name: Yorimi
description: The village chief of the aerofae tribe inhabiting Twilight Arboria. Despite her small frame, Yorimi is diligent and hardworking. Though she and her tribe are secretive and seclusive, her natural curiosity leads her to take great interest in outsiders - including Hikari.

name: Bouka
description: Once the maintainer of the mission board in Rubea, she was cut and replaced with Yukari. No one misses Bouka.

name: Kaede
description: The playable protagonist of Sw1tch. She has a tail, which changes colour with the direction of her gravity.
